name: Tomahawk Hills Golf Course
reasons: holes not all mapped in OSM (hole method: v2+structure)
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from club_site, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Blue, White. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

4: Blue tee walked back 25 yds behind the nearest OSM tee box along the hole line to reach the card's 427 (no mapped box at 427). Photo shows the marker on the cart path behind the forward pads.
6: Blue tee placed on the hole axis at the card's 173, 26 yds from the nearest OSM tee box. Green, bunker right and trees confirmed on the photo.
9: Routing and green OK (OSM green, bunker right). Page says the green is 97 ft below the tee (-27 yds 'play it like' 163 for 196).
18: Routing and green OK. Same large drop as 9 (green 93 ft below tee, -26 yds) on a 193 par 3; club site 193, golfify 178. Confirm plays-like on site.
